def format_report_cn(result):
    sc = result.scene
    items = result.items
    feat = result.features
    L = []

    L.append("=" * 70)
    icon, title, strat = _BANNER_CN.get(sc.scene, ("\uff1f", sc.scene.value, ""))
    L.append("[{}] {} (\u7f6e\u4fe1\u5ea6={:.0%})".format(icon, title, sc.confidence))
    L.append("    \u5904\u7f6e\u7b56\u7565\uff1a" + strat)
    if sc.is_mixed and sc.runner_up:
        L.append("    \u26a0 \u6df7\u5408\u573a\u666f\uff1a\u6b21\u9ad8\u5206\u573a\u666f=[{}]".format(sc.runner_up))

    tags = []
    if feat.has_speaker_tags:
        tags.append("\u5bf9\u8bdd\u4f53({}人)".format(len(feat.speakers)))
    if feat.is_monologue:
        tags.append("\u72ec\u767d\u4f53")
    if feat.has_date_header:
        tags.append("\u542b\u65e5\u671f\u5934")
    if tags:
        L.append("    \u7bc7\u7ae0\u7ed3\u6784\uff1a" + "\u3001".join(tags))

    if sc.hits:
        cn_hits = [_CAT_CN.get(h, h) for h in sc.hits[:8]]
        L.append("    \u547d\u4e2d\u5173\u952e\u8bcd\uff1a" + "\u3001".join(cn_hits))

    if sc.scores:
        L.append("    \u573a\u666f\u5f97\u5206\uff1a" + "\uff1b".join(k + "=" + str(v) for k, v in list(sc.scores.items())[:5]))

    L.append("-" * 70)
    L.append("[\u5904\u7406\u540e\u6587\u672c]")
    L.append(result.marked_text)
    L.append("-" * 70)

    bk = {a: [] for a in ActionType}
    for it in items:
        bk[it.action].append(it)

    def show(act, title, note=""):
        lst = bk[act]
        if not lst:
            return
        L.append("")
        L.append("[{}] {} (\u5171{}处)".format(_ICON_CN[act], title, len(lst)))
        if note:
            L.append("    " + note)
        for it in lst[:15]:
            t = it.text.strip()
            if len(t) > 60:
                t = t[:60] + "..."
            L.append("    - [{}] \"{}\" \u2192 {}".format(it.type.value, t, it.reason))

    show(ActionType.BLOCK_AND_ALERT,
         "\u7269\u7406\u62e6\u622a + \u5f3a\u8b66\u544a",
         "\u7edd\u5bf9\u4e0d\u8981\u900f\u9732\uff01\u771f\u6b63\u7684\u8b66\u5bdf\u7edd\u4e0d\u4f1a\u7535\u8bdd\u7d22\u8981\u5bc6\u7801/\u9a8c\u8bc1\u7801\uff01")
    show(ActionType.MASK_SILENTLY,
         "\u5df2\u9759\u9ed8\u6253\u7801\uff08\u7981\u6b62\u4e0a\u4f20\uff09",
         "\u672c\u573a\u666f\u4e0b\u5c5e\u9ad8\u5ea6\u654f\u611f\u4fe1\u606f\uff0c\u5df2\u7981\u6b62\u79bb\u5f00\u672c\u5730\u8bbe\u5907\u3002")
    show(ActionType.MASK_AND_ASK,
         "\u5df2\u6253\u7801\uff08\u4e0a\u4f20\u524d\u9700\u786e\u8ba4\uff09",
         "\u8bf7\u786e\u8ba4\u7528\u9014\u540e\u518d\u51b3\u5b9a\u662f\u5426\u53d1\u9001\u81f3\u4e91\u7aef\u3002")
    show(ActionType.VERIFY_IDENTITY,
         "\u8bf7\u5148\u6838\u5b9e\u8eab\u4efd",
         "\u5efa\u8bae\u6302\u65ad\u7535\u8bdd\uff0c\u62e8\u6253\u5b98\u65b9\u53f7\u7801\u786e\u8ba4\u5bf9\u65b9\u8eab\u4efd\u3002")
    show(ActionType.GENTLE_REMIND,
         "\u6e29\u548c\u63d0\u9192")

    frauds = [it for it in items if it.source == "fraud"]
    if frauds:
        stages = sorted({it.stage for it in frauds if it.stage})
        L.append("")
        L.append("\u8bc8\u9a97\u9636\u6bb5\u547d\u4e2d\uff1a" + " \u2192 ".join(stages))

    has_block = bool(bk[ActionType.BLOCK_AND_ALERT])
    if sc.scene == SceneType.TELECOM_FRAUD and has_block:
        L.append("")
        L.append("=" * 70)
        L.append("\u26a0\u26a0\u26a0 \u6781\u5ea6\u5371\u9669 - \u8bf7\u7acb\u5373\u6302\u65ad\u7535\u8bdd\uff01")
        L.append("\u62e8\u6253 96110\uff08\u5168\u56fd\u53cd\u8bc8\u4e13\u7ebf\uff09\u6216 110 \u62a5\u8b66\uff01")
        L.append("=" * 70)
    elif has_block:
        L.append("")
        L.append("=" * 70)
        L.append("\u26a0 \u68c0\u6d4b\u5230\u88ab\u62e6\u622a\u5185\u5bb9\uff0c\u8bf7\u8c28\u614e\u5904\u7406\u3002")
        L.append("=" * 70)

    if not any(bk[a] for a in ActionType if a != ActionType.PASS):
        L.append("")
        L.append("[\u2713] \u672a\u53d1\u73b0\u9690\u79c1\u95ee\u9898\u6216\u53ef\u7591\u6a21\u5f0f\u3002")

    return "\n".join(L)

# ==================== MAIN ====================

def main():
    print("=" * 70)
    print("  \u573a\u666f\u611f\u77e5\u9690\u79c1\u8bc6\u522b\u4e0e\u7b56\u7565\u5f15\u64ce")
    print("=" * 70)
    print("  \u5b8c\u5168\u672c\u5730\u8fd0\u884c\uff0c\u65e0\u7f51\u7edc\u8bf7\u6c42\uff0c\u65e0\u6570\u636e\u4e0a\u4f20\u3002")
    print("  \u8f93\u5165\u6587\u672c \u2192 \u573a\u666f\u8bc6\u522b \u2192 \u9690\u79c1\u68c0\u6d4b \u2192 \u7b56\u7565\u5904\u7f6e")
    print("-" * 70)
    print("  \u76f4\u63a5\u8f93\u5165\u6587\u672c + \u56de\u8f66    \u5206\u6790\u5355\u884c\u6587\u672c")
    print("  \u8f93\u5165 ```                   \u8fdb\u5165\u591a\u884c\u6a21\u5f0f\uff0c\u518d\u8f93\u5165 ``` \u7ed3\u675f")
    print("  :file <\u8def\u5f84>               \u8bfb\u53d6\u6587\u4ef6\u5206\u6790")
    print("  :save <\u8def\u5f84>               \u5bfc\u51faJSON\u7ed3\u679c")
    print("  :demo                        \u8fd0\u884c\u5185\u7f6e\u793a\u4f8b")
    print("  :q                           \u9000\u51fa")
    print("=" * 70)

    det = PrivacyDetector()
    last = None

    while True:
        try:
            line = input("\n> ").rstrip("\n")
        except (EOFError, KeyboardInterrupt):
            print()
            break

        cmd = line.strip()
        if not cmd:
            continue
        if cmd in (":q", "quit", "exit"):
            break
        if cmd == ":demo":
            run_demo(det)
            continue

        if cmd == "```":
            print("(\u591a\u884c\u8f93\u5165\u6a21\u5f0f\uff0c\u8f93\u5165 ``` \u7ed3\u675f)")
            buf = []
            while True:
                try:
                    l = input()
                except (EOFError, KeyboardInterrupt):
                    break
                if l.strip() == "```":
                    break
                buf.append(l)
            text = "\n".join(buf)
        elif cmd.startswith(":file"):
            path = cmd[5:].strip().strip("\"'")
            if not path:
                print("\u7528\u6cd5\uff1a:file <\u6587\u4ef6\u8def\u5f84>")
                continue
            try:
                with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    text = f.read()
                print("(\u5df2\u8bfb\u53d6 {} \u5b57\u7b26)".format(len(text)))
            except Exception as e:
                print("\u9519\u8bef\uff1a" + str(e))
                continue
        elif cmd.startswith(":save"):
            path = cmd[5:].strip().strip("\"'") or "privacy_result.json"
            if not last:
                print("\u8fd8\u6ca1\u6709\u5206\u6790\u7ed3\u679c")
                continue
            try:
                data = {
                    "\u573a\u666f": last.scene.scene.value,
                    "\u7f6e\u4fe1\u5ea6": last.scene.confidence,
                    "\u6df7\u5408\u573a\u666f": last.scene.is_mixed,
                    "\u5904\u7406\u540e\u6587\u672c": last.marked_text,
                    "\u8bc6\u522b\u9879": [it.to_dict() for it in last.items],
                }
                with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    json.dump(data, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
                print("\u5df2\u4fdd\u5b58\u81f3 " + path)
            except Exception as e:
                print("\u9519\u8bef\uff1a" + str(e))
            continue
        else:
            text = line

        if not text.strip():
            continue

        result = det.detect(text)
        last = result
        print(format_report_cn(result))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()


## ChatGPT:
通读了一遍，隐私检测主体逻辑没问题，但有几处会实际影响结果的 bug 和一堆识别准确性问题。按严重程度列一下，输出相关的先按你的要求跳过。

## 真正会出错的 bug

**1. `_SP` 说话人检测会把病历/表单字段头当成说话人**

```python
_SP = re.compile(r"^\s*([A-Za-z\u4e00-\u9fa5][A-Za-z\u4e00-\u9fa5_\-\u00b7]{0,10})\s*[:\uff1a]\s*\S")
```

只要一行以"XX：内容"开头就算一个说话人，这会把 `主诉：`、`既往史：`、`过敏史：`、`初步诊断：`、`医嘱：`、`联系电话：` 全部当成说话人。跑 demo 2 时，`speakers` 会被识别成 7-8 个人，`has_speaker_tags=True`，`is_dialogue=True`。

虽然 MEDICAL 场景的权重里没用到 `has_speaker_tags`，恰好没把场景打偏，但：
- TELECOM_FRAUD 的 `is_dialogue: 5` 会给病历加 5 分；
- 报告里会显示"对话体(8人)"，对用户是明显的误导；
- 换个场景（比如简单的日记带几行字段）就可能真的被打错。

建议至少做两点改造：
- 加一个常见字段头黑名单（主诉/既往史/过敏史/诊断/医嘱/姓名/性别/年龄/身份证号/联系电话/住址/日期/议题/议程/纪要…）；
- 或者要求同一个 prefix 至少出现 ≥2 次才计入 `speakers`，并把 turns 的判断也挂钩在"重复出现的说话人"上。

**2. `mark_text` 处理重叠区间会把文本切坏**

```python
body = sorted([i for i in items if i.source != "fraud"], key=lambda x: -x.start)
for it in body:
    ...
    text = text[:it.start] + r + text[it.end:]
```

从右往左替换只在"所有区间不重叠"时成立。一旦有包含关系（典型场景：solicit 捕到整句`把你的卡号6228…告诉我`，rule 又在句内捕到卡号本身），内层先被替换后外层的 `it.end` 已经越界或指向替换文本中间，结果会把 rule 的替换片段吃掉一截。

修法两种：
- 替换前做一次区间去重/选择（同一区段按优先级只保留一个）；
- 或者按从右到左跳过"已经被覆盖的"区间。

**3. `merge_items` 只按同类型去重，跨类型重叠会双报**

```python
hit = next((i for i, m in enumerate(merged) if it.start < m.end and it.end > m.start and it.type == m.type), -1)
```

身份证号的 18 位数字也能被 BANK_CARD 的 `\d{16,19}` 正则命中，只要 luhn 恰好通过，同一串数字会既标为"身份证号"又标为"银行卡号"。另外 `sol/frd` 直接 `+ merged` 拼接，没有和 nrm 做任何重叠检查，solicit 跟 rule 命中同一段数字时也会双报。

建议：去重判断去掉 `it.type == m.type` 这个限制，再按 `_SRC_PRI` + 覆盖长度决定保留谁。

**4. BIRTHDAY 没捕获组**

```python
r"(?:\u751f\u65e5|\u51fa\u751f)[\u662f\u5728\u4e8e:\uff1a\s]*\d{4}\u5e74\d{1,2}\u6708\d{1,2}\u65e5"
```

`context_detect` 里走的是 `m.groups() and m.group(1)` 分支，没捕获组就 fallback 到整体 `m.group()`，意味着被标注/打码的是"生日是2000年1月1日"整段，而不是日期本身。如果你想掩码的粒度是日期，需要把日期部分套上一个 `()`。

## 识别覆盖/准确性问题

**5. NAME 规则过窄**

现在要么必须有引导词 `我叫/名字叫/姓名是`，要么必须跟着 `先生/女士/老师/医生/经理/警官` 这类后缀。像 `张三今天来了`、`和李明一起吃饭`、`跟王总对接` 都抓不到。真实场景里绝大多数名字都是这种裸形式。

**6. AGE 只认 `(我|他|她)(今年|现在)\d{1,3}(岁|周岁)`**

demo 2 里 `张三，男，52岁` 直接漏掉。需要支持"姓名,性别,年龄"或"X岁的患者/用户"这类模式。

**7. ADDRESS 要求同时出现省/市/区 和 路/街/道**

现实地址很多是"XX市XX区XX小区X栋X单元X室"或"XX县XX镇XX村"，这些全漏。建议把末端的 `路|街|道|巷|大街|大道` 放开，允许 `小区|村|镇|园|公寓|社区` 等。

**8. 欺诈检测里的 `权威机构` 规则会误伤新闻/闲聊**

```python
("身份冒充", SEV_WARN, r"(?:公安局|派出所|...)", "权威机构")
```

只要文本提到"公安局"就算"身份冒充"命中。随便一句"昨天路过派出所"都会打中。应该跟 `我是…` 这种自称模式组合判断，或者单独命中时降权为提示级。

**9. `_ASK_CUE` 太宽会在无关句里误报**

`是多少` / `是什么` 这种疑问尾在很多正常问句里也存在。句级 fallback 时只要和核心敏感词同句就标为 DANGER（物理拦截），容错空间太小。可以要求 cue 和 term 之间的字距有个上限（比如 10 个字符），或者排除掉"学习/爱好/工作"等明显非敏感的宾语上下文。

**10. CORE_SENSITIVE 不含 PHONE**

客服、物流、电商、面试等场景如果对方开口要手机号，当前走的是 `MASK_AND_ASK` 或更弱的分支，没有身份核实这档。诈骗近年很大一类是"冒充客服/快递"要手机号 + 验证码。可以考虑把 PHONE 纳入"高敏类"或者在客服/物流场景单独加一个"核实身份"分支。

## 场景判定边界

**11. `is_monologue` 的判据对第三人称记录完全不工作**

```python
is_m = fp > sp * 2 and not has_sp and fp >= 3
```

病历、客户信息登记、工单这种"第三人称档案"全是 fp=0，永远判为非独白。而 demo 2 这类明显不是对话的文本因为 bug #1 又被判为 is_dialogue。所以篇章结构的两个标签对一大类文本都是错的。建议把"字段头密度高 + 无重复说话人"作为一种独立结构（表单/档案），而不是硬塞进 dialogue/monologue 二选一。

**12. `SceneDetector._score` 的类别惩罚和锚点加权耦合**

```python
if cats and hc < mc:
    sc *= 0.5
```

如果某个 profile 的 anchor 命中已经很高、但只命中 1 个类别，整体 ×0.5 会把结果拖得偏低；反过来对完全没 anchor、只靠类别堆分的 profile（比如 social_chat）又没触发。这个规则在 profile 之间不太对称，容易出现"短且典型"的文本得不到应有分数。

**13. `fraud_items` 加权直接判 `>= 2 danger` 才生效**

单条明显的危险信号（例如一句"你涉嫌洗钱"）场景分不会被显著抬升。对电诈这种场景，单条高置信度 danger 其实就该抬 TELECOM_FRAUD 的权重，不该等到 2 条。

## 小问题 & 鲁棒性

- **phone 打码丢格式**：`partial_mask` 用 `re.sub(r"\D","",text)` 剥掉了分隔符再拼，`138-1234-5678` 会变成 `138****5678`，用户视觉上识别不出来是同一个号。可以保留原字符串结构只替换数字。
- **`_FRAUD` 的 `身份冒充` 自称模式**用的是 `SEV_WARN`，但 "我是公安/反诈" 这种自称其实比"权威机构"字面出现更危险，建议升级到 `SEV_DANGER`。
- **split_sentences 不认英文句号 `.`**，中英混排文本会把一大段当作一句。
- **solicit 句级 fallback 遇到一句同时问多项（如密码+验证码）只记第一个**，`for pt in ...: ... break`。
- **LANDLINE 规则必须带分隔符**：`0\d{2,3}[-\s]\d{7,8}`，但现实中纯数字的 `01012345678` 也常见，而且会和手机号规则产生边界歧义。
- **Luhn 对国内银行卡覆盖没问题，但对随机 16-19 位数字（订单号、流水号）有一定几率通过**，建议再加 BIN 段白名单或长度分布过滤。
- **`_PROFILES` 用 `\uXXXX` 转义写**，读起来很费劲，维护负担大。直接用汉字写（源码保持 UTF-8）更好读；或者抽成外部 JSON/YAML 文件。
- **`DetectionResult.features.speakers` 是 `set`**，想序列化成 JSON 时会报错，`to_dict` 没覆盖这个结构。

## 一个结构性建议

现在 solicit / fraud / rule / context 四路检测结果是在最后 `merge_items` 里简单拼接的，重叠处理也散落在 `merge_items` 和 `mark_text` 两处。建议抽一个 Interval 层：
1. 所有检测器统一产出区间 + 标签 + 置信度；
2. 单独一个 resolver 做跨类型/跨来源的区间合并（保留优先级最高、覆盖最大的那条）；
3. 策略和打码都基于合并后的"干净"区间集合。

这样前面说的 bug #2、#3、以及后面扩展新检测器时的互相干扰都能一并解决。

import os
os.environ["HF_ENDPOINT"] = "https://hf-mirror.com"
os.environ["HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET"] = "1"
os.environ["HF_HUB_DISABLE_SYMLINKS_WARNING"] = "1"

import queue
import re
import sys
import threading
import time
import wave
from collections import deque
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import sounddevice as sd
from faster_whisper import WhisperModel

# ===== 配置 =====
PARTIAL_MODEL_NAME = "small"    # 临时结果用，快
FINAL_MODEL_NAME = "medium"     # 定稿用，准
USE_DUAL_MODEL = True           # 内存不够改成 False，两阶段都用 FINAL_MODEL_NAME

LANGUAGE = "zh"
SAMPLE_RATE = 16000
BLOCK_DURATION = 0.03
BLOCK_SIZE = int(SAMPLE_RATE * BLOCK_DURATION)

CALIBRATION_SECONDS = 1.0
THRESHOLD_MULTIPLIER = 2.5
MIN_THRESHOLD = 0.004
MAX_THRESHOLD = 0.050

COMMIT_SILENCE = 1.0
PRE_ROLL = 0.4
MAX_SEGMENT_DURATION = 20.0
MIN_SEGMENT_DURATION = 0.5

PARTIAL_MIN_DURATION = 0.6
PARTIAL_INTERVAL = 0.25

HOT_WORDS = "嗯，好的，我们来聊一聊。"
# ================

_ts = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
LOG_FILE = Path(f"transcript_{_ts}.txt")
AUDIO_FILE = Path(f"audio_{_ts}.wav")

_vad_available = True

HALLUCINATION_PATTERNS = [
    r"请?使用简体中文",
    r"保留?标点符号",
    r"以下是普通话",
    r"请不吝点赞",
    r"字幕[由组].{0,20}(提供|制作|翻译)",
    r"明镜与?点点栏目",
    r"^谢谢(大家)?(观看|收看)[。.!！]?$",
    r"^请订阅[。.!！]?$",
    r"^(多谢|感谢)(大家)?(观看|收看|聆听)",
    r"MBC\s*뉴스",
    r"下集?再见",
    r"中文字幕",
]
_hallu_re = re.compile("|".join(HALLUCINATION_PATTERNS))


def is_hallucination(text: str) -> bool:
    if not text:
        return True
    t = text.strip()
    if not t:
        return True
    if _hallu_re.search(t):
        return True
    if len(t) >= 6:
        half = len(t) // 2
        for size in range(2, half + 1):
            chunk = t[:size]
            if chunk * 3 in t:
                return True
    return False


def clean_text(text: str) -> str:
    if not text:
        return ""
    parts = re.split(r"(?<=[。！？!?.])", text)
    kept = [p for p in parts if p.strip() and not _hallu_re.search(p)]
    return "".join(kept).strip()


def calibrate(seconds):
    print(f"🔧 测环境噪声 {seconds:.1f} 秒，别说话...")
    rec = sd.rec(int(seconds * SAMPLE_RATE), samplerate=SAMPLE_RATE,
                 channels=1, dtype="float32")
    sd.wait()
    f = rec.flatten()
    n = max(1, len(f) // BLOCK_SIZE)
    rms_list = [float(np.sqrt(np.mean(f[i*BLOCK_SIZE:(i+1)*BLOCK_SIZE]**2)))
                for i in range(n)]
    noise = float(np.median(rms_list))
    th = float(np.clip(noise * THRESHOLD_MULTIPLIER, MIN_THRESHOLD, MAX_THRESHOLD))
    print(f"   噪声≈{noise:.5f}  触发阈值={th:.5f}\n")
    return th


def transcribe(audio, model, final=False):
    global _vad_available
    peak = float(np.max(np.abs(audio)))
    if peak > 1e-6:
        audio = (audio * (0.95 / peak)).astype(np.float32)
    else:
        audio = audio.astype(np.float32)

    kwargs = dict(
        language=LANGUAGE,
        beam_size=5 if final else 1,
        best_of=5 if final else 1,
        temperature=0.0,
        condition_on_previous_text=False,
        hotwords=HOT_WORDS,
        no_speech_threshold=0.6,
        log_prob_threshold=-0.8,
        compression_ratio_threshold=2.4,
    )
    if _vad_available and final:
        kwargs["vad_filter"] = True
        kwargs["vad_parameters"] = dict(min_silence_duration_ms=300)

    try:
        segs, _ = model.transcribe(audio, **kwargs)
        text = "".join(s.text for s in segs).strip()
    except TypeError:
        kwargs.pop("hotwords", None)
        segs, _ = model.transcribe(audio, **kwargs)
        text = "".join(s.text for s in segs).strip()
    except Exception as e:
        if _vad_available and ("vad" in str(e).lower() or "onnx" in str(e).lower()):
            _vad_available = False
            kwargs.pop("vad_filter", None)
            kwargs.pop("vad_parameters", None)
            segs, _ = model.transcribe(audio, **kwargs)
            text = "".join(s.text for s in segs).strip()
        else:
            raise

    return clean_text(text)


def load_model(name):
    print(f"⏳ 加载模型 {name}...")
    t0 = time.time()
    m = WhisperModel(name, device="cpu", compute_type="int8",
                     cpu_threads=max(4, os.cpu_count() or 4))
    print(f"   ✅ 完成（{time.time() - t0:.1f}s）")
    return m


def main():
    final_model = load_model(FINAL_MODEL_NAME)
    if USE_DUAL_MODEL and PARTIAL_MODEL_NAME != FINAL_MODEL_NAME:
        partial_model = load_model(PARTIAL_MODEL_NAME)
    else:
        partial_model = final_model
    print()

    threshold = calibrate(CALIBRATION_SECONDS)

    # 打开 WAV 文件（整个会话的音频都写进去）
    wav_fp = wave.open(str(AUDIO_FILE), "wb")
    wav_fp.setnchannels(1)
    wav_fp.setsampwidth(2)  # int16
    wav_fp.setframerate(SAMPLE_RATE)
    wav_lock = threading.Lock()

    print(f"📝 文字保存到：{LOG_FILE}")
    print(f"🎵 音频保存到：{AUDIO_FILE}（所有听到的声音都会存）")
    print("💡 底部 ✏️ 是实时预览（小模型），停顿后由大模型定稿")
    print("💡 Ctrl+C 退出\n")
    print("=" * 60)

    audio_q = queue.Queue()
    stop_evt = threading.Event()
    counter = [0]
    log_fp = LOG_FILE.open("a", encoding="utf-8")

    task_lock = threading.Lock()
    pending_partial = [None]
    pending_final = queue.Queue()

    current_partial_text = [""]
    partial_shown = [False]

    def clear_line():
        sys.stdout.write("\r" + " " * 100 + "\r")
        sys.stdout.flush()

    def commit(text):
        counter[0] += 1
        ts = datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M:%S")
        line = f"[{counter[0]:03d}] {ts}  {text}"
        clear_line()
        print(line)
        log_fp.write(line + "\n")
        log_fp.flush()
        current_partial_text[0] = ""
        partial_shown[0] = False

    def show_partial(text):
        if not text or text == current_partial_text[0]:
            return
        current_partial_text[0] = text
        clear_line()
        shown = text[-70:] if len(text) > 70 else text
        sys.stdout.write(f"  ✏️  {shown}")
        sys.stdout.flush()
        partial_shown[0] = True

    def show_hint(msg):
        if partial_shown[0]:
            return
        clear_line()
        sys.stdout.write(msg)
        sys.stdout.flush()

    def write_wav(block_float):
        pcm = np.clip(block_float * 32767.0, -32768, 32767).astype(np.int16)
        with wav_lock:
            try:
                wav_fp.writeframes(pcm.tobytes())
            except Exception:
                pass

    def rec_cb(indata, frames, ti, s):
        audio_q.put(indata.copy().flatten())

    def asr_worker():
        while not stop_evt.is_set():
            # 定稿优先
            try:
                audio = pending_final.get(timeout=0.1)
                try:
                    text = transcribe(audio, final_model, final=True)
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"\n[定稿识别出错] {e}")
                    text = ""
                if text and not is_hallucination(text):
                    commit(text)
                else:
                    clear_line()
                    current_partial_text[0] = ""
                    partial_shown[0] = False
                continue
            except queue.Empty:
                pass

            with task_lock:
                audio = pending_partial[0]
                pending_partial[0] = None
            if audio is not None:
                try:
                    text = transcribe(audio, partial_model, final=False)
                except Exception:
                    text = ""
                if text and not is_hallucination(text):
                    if not pending_final.qsize():
                        show_partial(text)

    def processor():
        pre_blocks = int(PRE_ROLL / BLOCK_DURATION)
        pre_roll = deque(maxlen=pre_blocks)
        buf = []
        has_speech = False
        silence_blocks = 0
        last_partial_t = 0.0
        silence_lim = int(COMMIT_SILENCE / BLOCK_DURATION)
        max_blocks = int(MAX_SEGMENT_DURATION / BLOCK_DURATION)
        min_blocks = int(MIN_SEGMENT_DURATION / BLOCK_DURATION)

        while not stop_evt.is_set():
            try:
                block = audio_q.get(timeout=0.2)
            except queue.Empty:
                continue

            # 每一块音频都写入 WAV
            write_wav(block)

            rms = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(block ** 2)))

            if not has_speech:
                pre_roll.append(block)
                if rms > threshold:
                    has_speech = True
                    buf = list(pre_roll)
                    buf.append(block)
                    silence_blocks = 0
                    last_partial_t = time.time()
                    show_hint("  🎙️  听到了，继续说...")
            else:
                buf.append(block)
                if rms > threshold:
                    silence_blocks = 0
                else:
                    silence_blocks += 1

            need_commit = has_speech and (
                silence_blocks >= silence_lim or len(buf) >= max_blocks
            )

            now = time.time()
            if (has_speech and not need_commit
                    and len(buf) * BLOCK_DURATION >= PARTIAL_MIN_DURATION
                    and (now - last_partial_t) >= PARTIAL_INTERVAL):
                snap = np.concatenate(buf).copy()
                with task_lock:
                    pending_partial[0] = snap
                last_partial_t = now

            if need_commit:
                audio_arr = np.concatenate(buf)
                overall_rms = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(audio_arr ** 2)))
                if len(buf) >= min_blocks and overall_rms > threshold * 0.8:
                    pending_final.put(audio_arr)
                else:
                    clear_line()
                    current_partial_text[0] = ""
                    partial_shown[0] = False
                buf = []
                has_speech = False
                silence_blocks = 0
                pre_roll.clear()
                with task_lock:
                    pending_partial[0] = None

    threading.Thread(target=processor, daemon=True).start()
    threading.Thread(target=asr_worker, daemon=True).start()

    try:
        with sd.InputStream(samplerate=SAMPLE_RATE, channels=1, dtype="float32",
                            blocksize=BLOCK_SIZE, callback=rec_cb):
            while True:
                sd.sleep(200)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\n")
    finally:
        stop_evt.set()
        time.sleep(0.5)
        log_fp.close()
        with wav_lock:
            try:
                wav_fp.close()
            except Exception:
                pass
        print("=" * 60)
        print(f"共识别 {counter[0]} 句")
        print(f"文字 → {LOG_FILE}")
        print(f"音频 → {AUDIO_FILE}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
实时音频质量监测与指导系统 v2.2
================================
自适应阈值版本 - 启动时自动校准环境，动态调整所有检测门槛。

v2.2 改进：
  - 新增音量骤增检测
  - 风噪/喷麦基于校准基线的相对判断，大幅减少误报
  - 新增"音量偏小"提醒级别，在静音和正常音量之间增加过渡区
  - 新增"音量偏小持续"警告
  - 新增"转写质量持续偏低"提醒
  - 静音门槛收紧，只有真正接近无声才判静音
  - VAD改用能量+过零率+频谱质心综合判断

功能：
  - 启动校准：采集5秒环境数据，自动确定阈值
  - 音量过小/偏小/过大/骤降/骤增检测（相对阈值）
  - 削波（过载）检测
  - 持续静音检测（麦克风断开/距离过远）
  - 背景噪音估算（自适应底噪）
  - 风噪/喷麦检测（基于校准基线的相对判断）
  - 信噪比评估
  - 转写适合度评分 + 持续质量下降提醒
  - 自动增益建议
  - 实时音量可视化

依赖：pip install sounddevice numpy
"""

import time
import math
import threading
import collections
import sys
import os

try:
    import numpy as np
except ImportError:
    print("错误：请先安装 numpy")
    print("  pip install numpy")
    sys.exit(1)

try:
    import sounddevice as sd
except ImportError:
    print("错误：请先安装 sounddevice")
    print("  pip install sounddevice")
    sys.exit(1)


# ================================================================
#  基础配置（采集参数）
# ================================================================

class AudioConfig:
    """音频采集参数"""
    SAMPLE_RATE = 16000
    CHANNELS = 1
    CHUNK_SIZE = 1024
    DTYPE = "int16"

    FRAME_DURATION_MS = CHUNK_SIZE * 1000 / SAMPLE_RATE
    REPORT_INTERVAL_SEC = 0.3

    # 削波检测（硬件上限，不需要自适应）
    CLIP_THRESHOLD = 32000
    CLIP_RATIO_WARN = 0.01

    # 静音超时
    SILENCE_TIMEOUT_SEC = 10.0
    SILENCE_TIMEOUT_LONG = 25.0

    # 音量偏小持续时间（秒）
    LOW_VOLUME_PERSIST_SEC = 4.0

    # 音量骤变
    VOLUME_DROP_RATIO = 0.25
    VOLUME_SURGE_RATIO = 3.5
    VOLUME_DROP_WINDOW = 12

    # 风噪检测 - 相对于校准基线的倍数
    WIND_BASELINE_MULTIPLIER = 2.0

    # 信噪比
    SNR_POOR = 6
    SNR_FAIR = 12

    # 转写适合度
    TRANSCRIBE_SCORE_POOR = 30
    TRANSCRIBE_SCORE_FAIR = 60
    TRANSCRIBE_SCORE_GOOD = 80

    # 转写质量持续下降提醒
    TRANSCRIBE_LOW_PERSIST_SEC = 6.0

    # 校准参数
    CALIBRATION_SECONDS = 5


# ================================================================
#  自适应阈值管理器
# ================================================================

class AdaptiveThresholds:
    """
    根据环境校准和运行时数据动态计算检测阈值。

    校准阶段（前5秒）：
      - 安静时段 -> 确定底噪基线
      - 说话时段 -> 确定正常语音音量基线
      - 同时记录低频能量基线，用于风噪相对判断

    运行时持续更新：
      - 底噪用最近窗口最低10%的RMS
      - 语音基线用最近语音帧的中位数
    """

    def __init__(self):
        # 校准状态
        self.calibrated = False
        self.calibration_rms = []
        self.calibration_low_ratios = []
        self.calibration_start = 0

        # 基线值
        self.noise_floor = 50
        self.speech_baseline = 2000
        self.silence_rms = 30
        self.low_freq_baseline = 0.5

        # 动态阈值
        self.very_low_volume_rms = 80
        self.low_volume_rms = 200
        self.good_volume_min = 500
        self.good_volume_max = 15000
        self.high_volume_rms = 20000

        # 运行时自适应
        self._noise_window = collections.deque(maxlen=1000)
        self._speech_window = collections.deque(maxlen=500)
        self._last_adapt_time = 0
        self._adapt_interval = 5.0

    def start_calibration(self):
        self.calibration_rms = []
        self.calibration_low_ratios = []
        self.calibration_start = time.time()
        self.calibrated = False

    def feed_calibration(self, rms, low_freq_ratio):
        self.calibration_rms.append(rms)
        self.calibration_low_ratios.append(low_freq_ratio)

    def is_calibration_done(self):
        return time.time() - self.calibration_start >= AudioConfig.CALIBRATION_SECONDS

    def finish_calibration(self):
        if not self.calibration_rms:
            self.calibrated = True
            return

        data = sorted(self.calibration_rms)
        n = len(data)

        # 底噪：最低20%的平均值
        noise_n = max(3, n // 5)
        self.noise_floor = sum(data[:noise_n]) / noise_n

        # 静音门槛：底噪的1.2倍，只有真正无声才算
        self.silence_rms = max(15, self.noise_floor * 1.2)

        # 极低音量门槛
        self.very_low_volume_rms = max(30, self.noise_floor * 2.5)

        # 找语音部分
        speech_threshold = self.noise_floor * 3
        speech_frames = [r for r in data if r > speech_threshold]

        if len(speech_frames) >= 5:
            self.speech_baseline = float(np.median(speech_frames))
        else:
            self.speech_baseline = max(500, self.noise_floor * 15)

        # 低频能量基线（用于风噪判断）
        if self.calibration_low_ratios:
            self.low_freq_baseline = float(np.median(self.calibration_low_ratios))

        self._recalculate_thresholds()
        self.calibrated = True

        print("\n" + "=" * 55)
        print("  校准完成")
        print("=" * 55)
        print("  底噪水平: {:.0f} RMS ({:.1f} dB)".format(
            self.noise_floor,
            20 * math.log10(self.noise_floor / 32767 + 1e-10)
        ))
        print("  语音基线: {:.0f} RMS ({:.1f} dB)".format(
            self.speech_baseline,
            20 * math.log10(self.speech_baseline / 32767 + 1e-10)
        ))
        print("  低频能量基线: {:.2f}".format(self.low_freq_baseline))
        print("  静音门槛: {:.0f} RMS".format(self.silence_rms))
        print("  极低音量: < {:.0f} RMS".format(self.very_low_volume_rms))
        print("  音量偏小: < {:.0f} RMS".format(self.low_volume_rms))
        print("  正常音量: {:.0f} ~ {:.0f} RMS".format(
            self.good_volume_min, self.good_volume_max
        ))
        print("  音量过大: > {:.0f} RMS".format(self.high_volume_rms))
        print("=" * 55)
        print()

    def _recalculate_thresholds(self):
        nf = self.noise_floor
        sb = self.speech_baseline

        self.very_low_volume_rms = max(30, nf * 2.5)
        self.low_volume_rms = max(nf * 4, sb * 0.20)
        self.good_volume_min = max(nf * 5, sb * 0.35)
        self.good_volume_max = min(25000, sb * 2.5)
        self.high_volume_rms = max(15000, sb * 3.0)

    def update_runtime(self, rms, is_speech):
        self._noise_window.append(rms)
        if is_speech:
            self._speech_window.append(rms)

        now = time.time()
        if now - self._last_adapt_time < self._adapt_interval:
            return
        self._last_adapt_time = now

        if len(self._noise_window) >= 30:
            lst = sorted(self._noise_window)
            num = max(3, len(lst) // 10)
            new_nf = sum(lst[:num]) / num
            self.noise_floor = self.noise_floor * 0.7 + new_nf * 0.3

        if len(self._speech_window) >= 10:
            new_sb = float(np.median(list(self._speech_window)))
            self.speech_baseline = self.speech_baseline * 0.7 + new_sb * 0.3

        self.silence_rms = max(15, self.noise_floor * 1.2)
        self.very_low_volume_rms = max(30, self.noise_floor * 2.5)
        self._recalculate_thresholds()

# ================================================================
#  音频分析缓冲区
# ================================================================

class AudioBuffer:

    def __init__(self, max_seconds=60, frames_per_sec=15):
        cap = int(max_seconds * frames_per_sec)
        self.rms_history = collections.deque(maxlen=cap)
        self.peak_history = collections.deque(maxlen=cap)
        self.clip_history = collections.deque(maxlen=cap)
        self.zcr_history = collections.deque(maxlen=cap)
        self.low_energy_ratio = collections.deque(maxlen=cap)
        self.is_speech = collections.deque(maxlen=cap)
        self.timestamps = collections.deque(maxlen=cap)
        self.scores = collections.deque(maxlen=cap)

    def add(self, rms, peak, clip_ratio, zcr, low_ratio, speech, ts, score=50):
        self.rms_history.append(rms)
        self.peak_history.append(peak)
        self.clip_history.append(clip_ratio)
        self.zcr_history.append(zcr)
        self.low_energy_ratio.append(low_ratio)
        self.is_speech.append(speech)
        self.timestamps.append(ts)
        self.scores.append(score)

    def recent_rms(self, n=8):
        lst = list(self.rms_history)
        return lst[-n:] if len(lst) >= n else lst

    def avg_rms(self, n=8):
        r = self.recent_rms(n)
        return sum(r) / len(r) if r else 0

    def silence_duration(self, silence_rms):
        """连续真正静音的时长"""
        if not self.rms_history:
            return 0
        count = 0
        for rms in reversed(self.rms_history):
            if rms < silence_rms:
                count += 1
            else:
                break
        return count * AudioConfig.CHUNK_SIZE / AudioConfig.SAMPLE_RATE

    def low_volume_duration(self, low_rms, silence_rms):
        """连续音量偏小但非静音的时长"""
        if not self.rms_history:
            return 0
        count = 0
        for rms in reversed(self.rms_history):
            if silence_rms <= rms < low_rms:
                count += 1
            else:
                break
        return count * AudioConfig.CHUNK_SIZE / AudioConfig.SAMPLE_RATE

    def low_score_duration(self, threshold):
        """连续低分时长"""
        if not self.scores:
            return 0
        count = 0
        for s in reversed(self.scores):
            if s < threshold:
                count += 1
            else:
                break
        return count * AudioConfig.CHUNK_SIZE / AudioConfig.SAMPLE_RATE

    def speech_ratio(self, n=30):
        lst = list(self.is_speech)[-n:]
        return sum(lst) / len(lst) if lst else 0

    def recent_low_ratios(self, n=8):
        lst = list(self.low_energy_ratio)
        return lst[-n:] if len(lst) >= n else lst


# ================================================================
#  帧级分析器
# ================================================================

class FrameAnalyzer:

    @staticmethod
    def analyze(samples_int16, thresholds):
        samples = samples_int16.astype(np.float64).flatten()
        n = len(samples)
        if n == 0:
            return {
                "rms": 0, "peak": 0, "clip_ratio": 0,
                "zcr": 0, "low_energy_ratio": 0,
                "spectral_centroid": 0,
                "is_speech": False, "is_zero": True,
                "db": -100,
            }

        rms = np.sqrt(np.mean(samples ** 2))
        peak = np.max(np.abs(samples))
        db = 20 * math.log10(rms / 32767 + 1e-10)

        clip_count = np.sum(np.abs(samples) >= AudioConfig.CLIP_THRESHOLD)
        clip_ratio = clip_count / n

        signs = np.sign(samples)
        zcr = np.sum(np.abs(np.diff(signs)) > 0) / (n - 1) if n > 1 else 0

        low_ratio = 0.0
        spectral_centroid = 0.0
        if n >= 256:
            fft = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(samples * np.hanning(n)))
            freqs = np.fft.rfftfreq(n, d=1.0 / AudioConfig.SAMPLE_RATE)
            total_energy = np.sum(fft ** 2) + 1e-10
            low_mask = freqs <= 300
            low_energy = np.sum(fft[low_mask] ** 2)
            low_ratio = low_energy / total_energy
            spectral_centroid = np.sum(freqs * fft) / (np.sum(fft) + 1e-10)

        # VAD：能量 + 过零率 + 频谱质心
        energy_ok = rms > thresholds.very_low_volume_rms
        zcr_ok = 0.01 < zcr < 0.5
        spectral_ok = 200 < spectral_centroid < 5000
        is_speech = energy_ok and (zcr_ok or spectral_ok)

        is_zero = peak < 2

        return {
            "rms": rms,
            "peak": peak,
            "clip_ratio": clip_ratio,
            "zcr": zcr,
            "low_energy_ratio": low_ratio,
            "spectral_centroid": spectral_centroid,
            "is_speech": is_speech,
            "is_zero": is_zero,
            "db": db,
        }

    @staticmethod
    def analyze_for_calibration(samples_int16):
        """校准用的简化分析"""
        samples = samples_int16.astype(np.float64).flatten()
        n = len(samples)
        if n == 0:
            return 0, 0.5

        rms = np.sqrt(np.mean(samples ** 2))

        low_ratio = 0.5
        if n >= 256:
            fft = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(samples * np.hanning(n)))
            freqs = np.fft.rfftfreq(n, d=1.0 / AudioConfig.SAMPLE_RATE)
            total_energy = np.sum(fft ** 2) + 1e-10
            low_mask = freqs <= 300
            low_energy = np.sum(fft[low_mask] ** 2)
            low_ratio = low_energy / total_energy

        return rms, low_ratio


# ================================================================
#  问题诊断器
# ================================================================

class IssueDiagnoser:

    def __init__(self):
        self.cooldowns = {}
        self.cooldown_sec = {
            Issue.VOLUME_TOO_LOW: 8,
            Issue.VOLUME_LOW_PERSIST: 20,
            Issue.VOLUME_TOO_HIGH: 10,
            Issue.VOLUME_DROP: 15,
            Issue.VOLUME_SURGE: 15,
            Issue.CLIPPING: 5,
            Issue.SILENCE: 15,
            Issue.SILENCE_LONG: 25,
            Issue.MIC_DISCONNECT: 8,
            Issue.BACKGROUND_NOISE: 30,
            Issue.WIND_NOISE: 20,
            Issue.LOW_SNR: 20,
            Issue.DISTANCE_FAR: 15,
            Issue.NOT_TRANSCRIBABLE: 20,
            Issue.TRANSCRIBE_QUALITY_DROP: 20,
        }
        self._confirm_count = collections.Counter()
        self._confirm_required = {
            Issue.VOLUME_TOO_LOW: 6,
            Issue.VOLUME_TOO_HIGH: 5,
            Issue.VOLUME_DROP: 3,
            Issue.VOLUME_SURGE: 3,
            Issue.CLIPPING: 2,
            Issue.WIND_NOISE: 8,
            Issue.LOW_SNR: 6,
            Issue.BACKGROUND_NOISE: 10,
            Issue.DISTANCE_FAR: 8,
        }

    def diagnose(self, frame_info, buf, thresholds):
        now = time.time()
        candidates = set()
        rms = frame_info["rms"]

        # --- 麦克风断开 ---
        if frame_info["is_zero"]:
            recent = buf.recent_rms(8)
            if len(recent) >= 8 and all(r < 2 for r in recent):
                return self._filter_cooldown([Issue.MIC_DISCONNECT], now)

        # --- 削波/过载 ---
        if frame_info["clip_ratio"] > AudioConfig.CLIP_RATIO_WARN:
            candidates.add(Issue.CLIPPING)

        # --- 音量过大 ---
        if rms > thresholds.high_volume_rms and Issue.CLIPPING not in candidates:
            candidates.add(Issue.VOLUME_TOO_HIGH)

        # --- 静音检测（真正的静音：低于底噪水平）---
        silence_dur = buf.silence_duration(thresholds.silence_rms)
        if silence_dur >= AudioConfig.SILENCE_TIMEOUT_LONG:
            return self._filter_cooldown([Issue.SILENCE_LONG], now)
        elif silence_dur >= AudioConfig.SILENCE_TIMEOUT_SEC:
            candidates.add(Issue.SILENCE)

        # --- 音量偏小持续检测 ---
        low_vol_dur = buf.low_volume_duration(
            thresholds.low_volume_rms, thresholds.silence_rms
        )
        if low_vol_dur >= AudioConfig.LOW_VOLUME_PERSIST_SEC:
            candidates.add(Issue.VOLUME_LOW_PERSIST)
        elif (thresholds.silence_rms <= rms < thresholds.low_volume_rms
              and not frame_info["is_zero"]):
            candidates.add(Issue.VOLUME_TOO_LOW)

        # --- 风噪/喷麦（基于校准基线的相对判断）---
        if rms > thresholds.very_low_volume_rms:
            current_low_ratio = frame_info["low_energy_ratio"]
            baseline = thresholds.low_freq_baseline
            if (baseline > 0.01
                    and current_low_ratio > baseline * AudioConfig.WIND_BASELINE_MULTIPLIER
                    and current_low_ratio > 0.7):
                candidates.add(Issue.WIND_NOISE)

        # --- 音量骤降 ---
        if len(buf.rms_history) >= AudioConfig.VOLUME_DROP_WINDOW:
            prev_avg = buf.avg_rms(AudioConfig.VOLUME_DROP_WINDOW)
            if (prev_avg > thresholds.good_volume_min
                    and rms < prev_avg * AudioConfig.VOLUME_DROP_RATIO
                    and rms > thresholds.silence_rms):
                candidates.add(Issue.VOLUME_DROP)

        # --- 音量骤增 ---
        if len(buf.rms_history) >= AudioConfig.VOLUME_DROP_WINDOW:
            prev_avg = buf.avg_rms(AudioConfig.VOLUME_DROP_WINDOW)
            if (prev_avg > thresholds.silence_rms
                    and rms > prev_avg * AudioConfig.VOLUME_SURGE_RATIO
                    and rms > thresholds.good_volume_min):
                candidates.add(Issue.VOLUME_SURGE)

        # --- 背景噪音 ---
        if thresholds.noise_floor > thresholds.speech_baseline * 0.3:
            candidates.add(Issue.BACKGROUND_NOISE)

        # --- 信噪比 ---
        if frame_info["is_speech"] and thresholds.noise_floor > 10:
            snr = 20 * math.log10(rms / thresholds.noise_floor + 1e-10)
            if snr < AudioConfig.SNR_POOR:
                candidates.add(Issue.LOW_SNR)

        # --- 距离过远 ---
        if (thresholds.very_low_volume_rms < rms < thresholds.low_volume_rms * 1.2
                and frame_info["zcr"] < 0.08
                and not frame_info["is_speech"]
                and buf.speech_ratio(30) > 0.3):
            candidates.add(Issue.DISTANCE_FAR)

        # --- 转写质量持续偏低 ---
        low_score_dur = buf.low_score_duration(AudioConfig.TRANSCRIBE_SCORE_FAIR)
        if low_score_dur >= AudioConfig.TRANSCRIBE_LOW_PERSIST_SEC:
            candidates.add(Issue.TRANSCRIBE_QUALITY_DROP)

        # 连续确认过滤
        confirmed = []
        all_trackable = set(self._confirm_required.keys())

        for iss in candidates:
            if iss in all_trackable:
                self._confirm_count[iss] += 1
                if self._confirm_count[iss] >= self._confirm_required[iss]:
                    confirmed.append(iss)
                    self._confirm_count[iss] = 0
            else:
                confirmed.append(iss)

        for iss in list(self._confirm_count.keys()):
            if iss not in candidates:
                self._confirm_count[iss] = 0

        # 优先级去重
        if Issue.VOLUME_LOW_PERSIST in confirmed:
            confirmed = [i for i in confirmed if i != Issue.VOLUME_TOO_LOW]

        if Issue.TRANSCRIBE_QUALITY_DROP in confirmed:
            confirmed = [i for i in confirmed if i != Issue.NOT_TRANSCRIBABLE]

        # 骤增和过大不重复提示
        if Issue.CLIPPING in confirmed:
            confirmed = [i for i in confirmed
                         if i not in (Issue.VOLUME_TOO_HIGH, Issue.VOLUME_SURGE)]

        if Issue.VOLUME_TOO_HIGH in confirmed:
            confirmed = [i for i in confirmed if i != Issue.VOLUME_SURGE]

        return self._filter_cooldown(confirmed, now)

    def _filter_cooldown(self, issues, now):
        result = []
        for iss in issues:
            cd = self.cooldowns.get(iss, 0)
            if now >= cd:
                result.append(iss)
                self.cooldowns[iss] = now + self.cooldown_sec.get(iss, 10)
        return result


# ================================================================
#  转写适合度评分
# ================================================================

class TranscribeScorer:

    @staticmethod
    def score(frame_info, thresholds):
        s = 100.0
        rms = frame_info["rms"]

        # 音量评分
        if rms < thresholds.silence_rms:
            s -= 50
        elif rms < thresholds.very_low_volume_rms:
            s -= 35
        elif rms < thresholds.low_volume_rms:
            s -= 20
        elif rms > thresholds.high_volume_rms:
            s -= 20
        elif thresholds.good_volume_min <= rms <= thresholds.good_volume_max:
            s += 0
        else:
            s -= 5

        # 削波
        if frame_info["clip_ratio"] > 0.05:
            s -= 30
        elif frame_info["clip_ratio"] > 0.01:
            s -= 15

        # 信噪比
        nf = thresholds.noise_floor
        if nf > 10 and rms > nf:
            snr = 20 * math.log10(rms / nf + 1e-10)
            if snr < AudioConfig.SNR_POOR:
                s -= 25
            elif snr < AudioConfig.SNR_FAIR:
                s -= 10

        # 风噪（相对基线）
        current_low = frame_info["low_energy_ratio"]
        baseline = thresholds.low_freq_baseline
        if baseline > 0.01 and current_low > baseline * AudioConfig.WIND_BASELINE_MULTIPLIER:
            s -= 10

        # 背景噪音
        if nf > thresholds.speech_baseline * 0.3:
            s -= 15
        elif nf > thresholds.very_low_volume_rms * 2:
            s -= 5

        return max(0, min(100, s))


# ================================================================
#  自动增益建议
# ================================================================

class GainAdvisor:

    def __init__(self):
        self.suggested_gain = 1.0
        self.history = collections.deque(maxlen=50)

    def update(self, rms, clip_ratio, thresholds):
        self.history.append((rms, clip_ratio))
        if len(self.history) < 10:
            return

        avg_rms = sum(r for r, _ in self.history) / len(self.history)
        avg_clip = sum(c for _, c in self.history) / len(self.history)

        target = thresholds.speech_baseline

        if avg_clip > 0.01:
            self.suggested_gain = max(0.3, self.suggested_gain * 0.8)
        elif avg_rms < thresholds.low_volume_rms and avg_rms > 10:
            desired = target / avg_rms
            self.suggested_gain = min(5.0, desired * 0.8)
        elif avg_rms > thresholds.high_volume_rms:
            desired = target / avg_rms
            self.suggested_gain = max(0.3, desired * 1.1)
        else:
            self.suggested_gain = self.suggested_gain * 0.95 + 1.0 * 0.05

    def get_suggestion(self):
        g = self.suggested_gain
        if g > 1.8:
            return "建议：将麦克风增益调高至 {:.0f}%".format(g * 100)
        elif g < 0.6:
            return "建议：将麦克风增益调低至 {:.0f}%".format(g * 100)
        return None


# ================================================================
#  终端界面渲染
# ================================================================

class TerminalUI:

    METER_WIDTH = 40

    @staticmethod
    def volume_bar(rms, peak, clip_ratio):
        if rms < 1:
            level = 0
        else:
            level = int(20 * math.log10(rms / 32767 + 1e-10) + 80)
            level = max(0, min(TerminalUI.METER_WIDTH,
                               int(level * TerminalUI.METER_WIDTH / 60)))

        bar = ""
        for i in range(TerminalUI.METER_WIDTH):
            if i < level:
                if i > TerminalUI.METER_WIDTH * 0.85:
                    bar += "█"
                elif i > TerminalUI.METER_WIDTH * 0.65:
                    bar += "▓"
                else:
                    bar += "░"
            else:
                bar += "·"

        db = 20 * math.log10(rms / 32767 + 1e-10)
        clip_mark = " ⚡过载!" if clip_ratio > 0.01 else ""

        return "音量 [{bar}] {db:+.1f}dB (RMS:{rms:.0f}){clip}".format(
            bar=bar, db=db, rms=rms, clip=clip_mark
        )

    @staticmethod
    def status_line(score, speech, noise_floor):
        if score >= AudioConfig.TRANSCRIBE_SCORE_GOOD:
            sq = "★★★ 优秀"
        elif score >= AudioConfig.TRANSCRIBE_SCORE_FAIR:
            sq = "★★☆ 一般"
        elif score >= AudioConfig.TRANSCRIBE_SCORE_POOR:
            sq = "★☆☆ 较差"
        else:
            sq = "☆☆☆ 不可用"

        sp = "🗣 语音" if speech else "   静默"
        nf = "底噪:{:.0f}".format(noise_floor)

        return "转写质量:[{sq}]({score}分) {sp}  {nf}".format(
            sq=sq, score=int(score), sp=sp, nf=nf
        )

    @staticmethod
    def print_issue(issue_id):
        info = Issue.DESCRIPTIONS.get(issue_id)
        if not info:
            return

        border = "─" * 51
        print()
        print("┌" + border + "┐")

        header = " {icon} [{level}] {title}".format(**info)
        print("│" + header.ljust(51) + "│")
        print("│" + " " * 51 + "│")

        detail = info["detail"]
        while detail:
            chunk = detail[:47]
            detail = detail[47:]
            print("│  " + chunk.ljust(49) + "│")

        print("│" + " " * 51 + "│")

        for adv in info["advice"][:4]:
            line = "  → " + adv
            print("│" + line[:50].ljust(51) + "│")

        print("└" + border + "┘")
        print()

    @staticmethod
    def print_calibration_progress(elapsed, total):
        pct = min(1.0, elapsed / total)
        filled = int(30 * pct)
        bar = "█" * filled + "·" * (30 - filled)
        sys.stdout.write(
            "\r  校准中 [{bar}] {pct:.0f}%  请先安静几秒，然后正常说几句话".format(
                bar=bar, pct=pct * 100
            ))
        sys.stdout.flush()


# ================================================================
#  主监测引擎
# ================================================================

class AudioMonitor:

    def __init__(self, device_index=None):
        self.device_index = device_index
        self.running = False

        self.thresholds = AdaptiveThresholds()
        self.buffer = AudioBuffer()
        self.diagnoser = IssueDiagnoser()
        self.scorer = TranscribeScorer()
        self.gain_advisor = GainAdvisor()
        self.ui = TerminalUI()

        self.total_frames = 0
        self.total_speech_frames = 0
        self.total_issues = collections.Counter()
        self.start_time = 0

        self._latest_info = None
        self._latest_score = 0
        self._latest_issues = []
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        self._last_report_time = 0
        self._last_gain_time = 0

        self._calibrating = True

    @staticmethod
    def list_devices():
        print("\n可用的音频输入设备：")
        print("-" * 60)

        devices = sd.query_devices()
        input_devices = []
        default_input = sd.default.device[0]

        for i, dev in enumerate(devices):
            if dev["max_input_channels"] > 0:
                input_devices.append(i)
                default_mark = " [默认]" if i == default_input else ""
                print(
                    "  [{idx}] {name} (输入通道:{ch}, 采样率:{rate:.0f}Hz){mark}".format(
                        idx=i,
                        name=dev["name"],
                        ch=dev["max_input_channels"],
                        rate=dev["default_samplerate"],
                        mark=default_mark,
                    ))

        print("-" * 60)
        return input_devices

    def _audio_callback(self, indata, frames, time_info, status):
        now = time.time()
        samples = indata.copy().flatten()
        samples_i16 = (samples.astype(np.int16)
                       if samples.dtype != np.int16 else samples)

        # --- 校准阶段 ---
        if self._calibrating:
            rms, low_ratio = FrameAnalyzer.analyze_for_calibration(samples_i16)
            self.thresholds.feed_calibration(rms, low_ratio)
            return

        # --- 正常分析 ---
        info = FrameAnalyzer.analyze(samples_i16, self.thresholds)
        self.total_frames += 1
        if info["is_speech"]:
            self.total_speech_frames += 1

        # 转写评分
        score = self.scorer.score(info, self.thresholds)

        # 缓冲
        self.buffer.add(
            rms=info["rms"],
            peak=info["peak"],
            clip_ratio=info["clip_ratio"],
            zcr=info["zcr"],
            low_ratio=info["low_energy_ratio"],
            speech=info["is_speech"],
            ts=now,
            score=score,
        )

        # 自适应更新
        self.thresholds.update_runtime(info["rms"], info["is_speech"])

        # 增益
        self.gain_advisor.update(info["rms"], info["clip_ratio"], self.thresholds)

        # 诊断
        issues = self.diagnoser.diagnose(info, self.buffer, self.thresholds)

        # 不可转写判断
        if score < AudioConfig.TRANSCRIBE_SCORE_POOR:
            extra = self.diagnoser._filter_cooldown(
                [Issue.NOT_TRANSCRIBABLE], now
            )
            issues.extend(extra)

        with self._lock:
            self._latest_info = info
            self._latest_score = score
            self._latest_issues.extend(issues)

        for iss in issues:
            self.total_issues[iss] += 1

    def start(self):
        if self.device_index is not None:
            dev_info = sd.query_devices(self.device_index)
        else:
            default_idx = sd.default.device[0]
            dev_info = sd.query_devices(default_idx)
            self.device_index = default_idx

        print("\n正在使用音频设备: [{idx}] {name}".format(
            idx=self.device_index, name=dev_info["name"]
        ))
        print("采样率: {rate}Hz | 位深: 16bit | 声道: 单声道".format(
            rate=AudioConfig.SAMPLE_RATE
        ))
        print()

        # === 校准阶段 ===
        print("=" * 55)
        print("  🔧 环境校准")
        print("=" * 55)
        print("  接下来{}秒将采集环境音频，自动确定检测阈值。".format(
            AudioConfig.CALIBRATION_SECONDS
        ))
        print("  请先保持安静2-3秒，然后用正常音量说几句话。")
        print()

        self._calibrating = True
        self.thresholds.start_calibration()

        try:
            with sd.InputStream(
                device=self.device_index,
                samplerate=AudioConfig.SAMPLE_RATE,
                channels=AudioConfig.CHANNELS,
                dtype=AudioConfig.DTYPE,
                blocksize=AudioConfig.CHUNK_SIZE,
                callback=self._audio_callback,
            ):
                cal_start = time.time()
                while not self.thresholds.is_calibration_done():
                    elapsed = time.time() - cal_start
                    self.ui.print_calibration_progress(
                        elapsed, AudioConfig.CALIBRATION_SECONDS
                    )
                    time.sleep(0.1)

                print()
                self.thresholds.finish_calibration()
                self._calibrating = False

                print()
                print("=" * 55)
                print("  🎙  监测已启动 - 按 Ctrl+C 停止")
                print("=" * 55)
                print()

                self.running = True
                self.start_time = time.time()
                self._last_report_time = time.time()
                self._last_gain_time = time.time()

                while self.running:
                    self._update_display()
                    time.sleep(0.1)

        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            pass
        except Exception as e:
            print("\n错误：无法打开音频流 - " + str(e))
            print("请检查麦克风连接，或尝试指定其他设备")
            return
        finally:
            self.running = False
            self.print_summary()

    def _update_display(self):
        now = time.time()

        with self._lock:
            info = self._latest_info
            score = self._latest_score
            issues = list(self._latest_issues)
            self._latest_issues = []

        if info is None:
            return

        for iss in issues:
            self.ui.print_issue(iss)

        if now - self._last_report_time >= AudioConfig.REPORT_INTERVAL_SEC:
            vol_bar = self.ui.volume_bar(
                info["rms"], info["peak"], info["clip_ratio"]
            )
            status = self.ui.status_line(
                score, info["is_speech"], self.thresholds.noise_floor
            )

            sys.stdout.write("\r" + vol_bar + "  " + status + "    ")
            sys.stdout.flush()

            self._last_report_time = now

        if now - self._last_gain_time >= 15:
            gain_sug = self.gain_advisor.get_suggestion()
            if gain_sug:
                print("\n\n💡 " + gain_sug + "\n")
            self._last_gain_time = now

    def print_summary(self):
        duration = time.time() - self.start_time if self.start_time else 0

        print("\n\n")
        print("=" * 55)
        print("  📋 监测会话总结")
        print("=" * 55)
        print("  总时长: {:.1f} 秒".format(duration))
        print("  总帧数: {}".format(self.total_frames))
        if self.total_frames > 0:
            print("  语音帧: {} ({:.1f}%)".format(
                self.total_speech_frames,
                self.total_speech_frames / self.total_frames * 100,
            ))

        print()
        print("  最终自适应阈值：")
        t = self.thresholds
        print("    底噪: {:.0f} RMS".format(t.noise_floor))
        print("    语音基线: {:.0f} RMS".format(t.speech_baseline))
        print("    静音门槛: {:.0f} RMS".format(t.silence_rms))
        print("    极低音量: {:.0f} RMS".format(t.very_low_volume_rms))
        print("    音量偏小门槛: {:.0f} RMS".format(t.low_volume_rms))
        print("    正常音量: {:.0f} ~ {:.0f} RMS".format(
            t.good_volume_min, t.good_volume_max
        ))
        print("    音量过大门槛: {:.0f} RMS".format(t.high_volume_rms))
        print("    低频基线: {:.2f}".format(t.low_freq_baseline))

        if self.total_issues:
            print()
            print("  检测到的问题：")
            for iss, cnt in self.total_issues.most_common():
                info = Issue.DESCRIPTIONS.get(iss, {})
                title = info.get("title", iss)
                icon = info.get("icon", "")
                print("    {icon} {title}: {cnt}次".format(
                    icon=icon, title=title, cnt=cnt
                ))
        else:
            print()
            print("  ✅ 未检测到任何问题，音频质量良好！")

        gain_sug = self.gain_advisor.get_suggestion()
        if gain_sug:
            print()
            print("  💡 " + gain_sug)

        print()
        print("=" * 55)


# ================================================================
#  入口
# ================================================================

def main():
    print()
    print("=" * 55)
    print("  🎙  实时音频质量监测与指导系统  v2.2")
    print("      （自适应阈值版）")
    print("=" * 55)
    print()
    print("  本系统启动时自动校准环境，动态调整检测阈值。")
    print()
    print("  检测项目：")
    print("  🔈 音量偏小/过大/骤降/骤增  ⚡ 削波过载")
    print("  🔇 持续静音                🔌 麦克风断开")
    print("  🏭 背景噪音                🌬️  风噪/喷麦")
    print("  📊 信噪比评估              📏 距离过远")
    print("  📉 转写质量持续偏低        💡 增益调整建议")
    print()

    input_devices = AudioMonitor.list_devices()

    if not input_devices:
        print("\n错误：未找到任何音频输入设备！")
        print("请检查麦克风是否连接。")
        return

    print()
    choice = input("请选择设备编号 (直接回车使用默认设备): ").strip()

    device_idx = None
    if choice:
        try:
            device_idx = int(choice)
            if device_idx not in input_devices:
                print("无效的设备编号")
                return
        except ValueError:
            print("请输入数字")
            return

    monitor = AudioMonitor(device_index=device_idx)
    monitor.start()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()


隐私检测的代码我稍后发给你，好像有点长了这里输入不进去了，这些是我觉得有问题的地方，如果你觉得哪里可以改进的更好也可以继续改进。
先快速把两个问题拆开说，然后给具体改法。

## 关于 dBFS 总是负的

这不是 bug，是数字音频的物理定义。dBFS = decibels relative to Full Scale，参考点就是数字域的最大值（int16 的 32767）。公式 `20 * log10(rms / 32767)`，分子永远 ≤ 分母，所以结果一定 ≤ 0。

常见对照：
- `0 dBFS` = 顶格（削波边缘）
- `-6 dBFS` ≈ 一半幅度
- `-20 dBFS` 左右 = 正常说话舒适区
- `-40 dBFS` 以下 = 偏小
- `-60 dBFS` 以下 = 基本是底噪

所以显示负数是对的，关键是看落在哪个区间。界面上可以直接说明"目标 -30 ~ -12 dB"，用户就不会疑惑了。

---

## 转写变慢的根本原因

你的代码里有几处在偷偷烧 CPU，去掉之后不会影响准确度：

### 1. `best_of=5` 配 `temperature=0.0` 是无效开销

`best_of` 只在温度采样（temperature > 0）时生效。你温度是 0，走的是 beam search，`best_of` 相当于被忽略但在某些版本里仍会触发 fallback 重算。改成 1。

### 2. partial 每次都把整段越来越长的 buffer 重跑一遍

用户说 15 秒的话，每 0.25 秒就把 1s、2s... 一直到 15s 的音频从头跑一次 small 模型。到后期每次 partial 都要几秒 CPU 时间，队列会堆积。

**修复：partial 只跑最近 4~5 秒的滑动窗口**，大模型定稿时才用完整 buffer。

### 3. partial 没开 VAD

小模型对静音段非常容易产生幻觉和空转，VAD 过滤能让它只处理真正有声的部分，速度明显提升。

### 4. partial 模型可以再小一点

CPU + int8 下 `small` 做 0.25s 间隔的 partial 还是偏重。换 `base` 对"预览"场景足够，速度大约快 2 倍。

### 修改后的关键代码

```python
# ===== 配置 =====
PARTIAL_MODEL_NAME = "base"      # small → base，预览足够
FINAL_MODEL_NAME = "medium"
USE_DUAL_MODEL = True

PARTIAL_WINDOW_SEC = 5.0         # 新增：partial 只看最近 5 秒
PARTIAL_INTERVAL = 0.35          # 稍微拉大一点，减少堆积
# ... 其他不变
```

```python
def transcribe(audio, model, final=False):
    global _vad_available
    peak = float(np.max(np.abs(audio)))
    if peak > 1e-6:
        audio = (audio * (0.95 / peak)).astype(np.float32)
    else:
        audio = audio.astype(np.float32)

    kwargs = dict(
        language=LANGUAGE,
        beam_size=5 if final else 1,
        best_of=1,                         # ← 关键：从 5 改成 1
        temperature=0.0,
        condition_on_previous_text=False,
        hotwords=HOT_WORDS,
        no_speech_threshold=0.6,
        log_prob_threshold=-0.8,
        compression_ratio_threshold=2.4,
        without_timestamps=True,           # ← 不需要时间戳，省一点
    )
    # partial 也开 VAD，跳过静音段，速度和准确度双赢
    if _vad_available:
        kwargs["vad_filter"] = True
        kwargs["vad_parameters"] = dict(
            min_silence_duration_ms=300 if final else 200
        )

    try:
        segs, _ = model.transcribe(audio, **kwargs)
        text = "".join(s.text for s in segs).strip()
    except TypeError:
        kwargs.pop("hotwords", None)
        segs, _ = model.transcribe(audio, **kwargs)
        text = "".join(s.text for s in segs).strip()
    except Exception as e:
        if _vad_available and ("vad" in str(e).lower() or "onnx" in str(e).lower()):
            _vad_available = False
            kwargs.pop("vad_filter", None)
            kwargs.pop("vad_parameters", None)
            segs, _ = model.transcribe(audio, **kwargs)
            text = "".join(s.text for s in segs).strip()
        else:
            raise

    return clean_text(text)
```

然后在 processor 里改一下 partial 的音频切片：

```python
# 原来：
# snap = np.concatenate(buf).copy()

# 改成：
partial_blocks = int(PARTIAL_WINDOW_SEC / BLOCK_DURATION)
if len(buf) > partial_blocks:
    snap = np.concatenate(buf[-partial_blocks:]).copy()
else:
    snap = np.concatenate(buf).copy()
with task_lock:
    pending_partial[0] = snap
```

另外 `cpu_threads` 设过多反而因为上下文切换变慢。faster-whisper 在 CPU 上一般 `cpu_threads=4, num_workers=1` 最稳：

```python
m = WhisperModel(name, device="cpu", compute_type="int8",
                 cpu_threads=4, num_workers=1)
```

做完这几步，长句的 partial 延迟能从几秒降到亚秒级，final 的准确度基本不受影响（`best_of` 本来就没在 work，beam_size 保持 5）。如果机器更强，final 的 compute_type 可以尝试 `int8_float32`。

## 音频监测的界面刷新

你现在的问题是：实时音量条用 `\r` 覆盖，但问题提示 `print_issue` 是另起一块，所以界面会一直向下滚。想要"原地刷新+状态面板"的话，用 ANSI 控制码把整个面板当成一个固定高度的区域重绘就行。

核心思路：
- 第一帧，正常 print 出 N 行
- 之后每次刷新：`ESC[{N}A` 把光标抬回顶部，逐行 `ESC[2K` 清空后重写
- 没有问题时显示 `✅ 音频质量良好`，有问题时就把问题写进面板

把 `TerminalUI` 和 `_update_display` 换成下面这版：

```python
class TerminalUI:
    METER_WIDTH = 40
    PANEL_HEIGHT = 10          # 固定面板行数

    def __init__(self):
        self._drawn = False

    @staticmethod
    def _volume_bar(rms):
        if rms < 1:
            level = 0
        else:
            level = int(20 * math.log10(rms / 32767 + 1e-10) + 80)
            level = max(0, min(TerminalUI.METER_WIDTH,
                               int(level * TerminalUI.METER_WIDTH / 60)))
        bar = ""
        for i in range(TerminalUI.METER_WIDTH):
            if i < level:
                if i > TerminalUI.METER_WIDTH * 0.85:
                    bar += "█"
                elif i > TerminalUI.METER_WIDTH * 0.65:
                    bar += "▓"
                else:
                    bar += "░"
            else:
                bar += "·"
        return bar

    @staticmethod
    def _quality_label(score):
        if score >= AudioConfig.TRANSCRIBE_SCORE_GOOD:
            return "★★★ 优秀"
        if score >= AudioConfig.TRANSCRIBE_SCORE_FAIR:
            return "★★☆ 一般"
        if score >= AudioConfig.TRANSCRIBE_SCORE_POOR:
            return "★☆☆ 较差"
        return "☆☆☆ 不可用"

    def render(self, info, score, thresholds, active_issues, gain_sug):
        """
        active_issues: 当前正在发生的问题 id 列表（不是一次性弹的）
        """
        rms = info["rms"]
        peak = info["peak"]
        clip = info["clip_ratio"]
        speech = info["is_speech"]

        bar = self._volume_bar(rms)
        db = 20 * math.log10(rms / 32767 + 1e-10)
        clip_mark = " ⚡过载" if clip > 0.01 else ""

        # 组装 PANEL_HEIGHT 行
        lines = []
        lines.append("╭─ 🎙  音频质量监测 ─────────────────────────────────╮")
        lines.append(f"│ 音量 [{bar}] {db:+6.1f}dB  RMS:{int(rms):<5d}{clip_mark}")
        lines.append(f"│ 质量 {self._quality_label(score)} ({int(score)}分)   "
                     f"{'🗣 语音' if speech else '   静默'}   "
                     f"底噪:{int(thresholds.noise_floor):<4d}")
        lines.append("├────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤")

        # 内容区（6 行）
        content = self._build_content(active_issues, gain_sug)
        for ln in content[:6]:
            lines.append("│ " + ln)
        while len(lines) < TerminalUI.PANEL_HEIGHT - 1:
            lines.append("│")
        lines.append("╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯")

        self._write_lines(lines)

    def _build_content(self, issues, gain_sug):
        if not issues:
            out = ["状态: ✅ 音频质量良好，当前适合转写",
                   "",
                   "目标音量区间: -30 ~ -12 dB",
                   ""]
            if gain_sug:
                out.append("💡 " + gain_sug)
            return out

        # 优先级：严重 > 警告 > 提醒
        level_order = {"严重": 0, "警告": 1, "提醒": 2}
        issues = sorted(issues,
                        key=lambda i: level_order.get(
                            Issue.DESCRIPTIONS.get(i, {}).get("level", "提醒"), 3))

        out = []
        # 只展示最严重的 1~2 个，避免挤爆面板
        for iss in issues[:2]:
            info = Issue.DESCRIPTIONS.get(iss)
            if not info:
                continue
            out.append(f"{info['icon']} [{info['level']}] {info['title']}")
            out.append(f"   {info['detail'][:46]}")
            for adv in info["advice"][:2]:
                out.append(f"   → {adv[:46]}")
        return out

    def _write_lines(self, lines):
        if self._drawn:
            # 光标抬回面板顶部
            sys.stdout.write(f"\x1b[{TerminalUI.PANEL_HEIGHT}A")
        for ln in lines:
            # 清整行再写，防止上一帧残影
            sys.stdout.write("\x1b[2K" + ln + "\n")
        sys.stdout.flush()
        self._drawn = True
```

然后你需要维护一个"当前活跃问题"集合，而不是每次只在触发瞬间喷一次。可以在 `IssueDiagnoser` 外面加一层衰减：问题被诊断到就记上时间戳，N 秒内没再出现就从活跃集合移除：

```python
class AudioMonitor:
    def __init__(self, device_index=None):
        # ...（原来的内容）
        self._active_issues = {}        # issue_id -> last_seen_ts
        self._issue_ttl = 3.0           # 3 秒没再触发就从面板撤下

    # 在 _audio_callback 里，把原来 self._latest_issues.extend(issues)
    # 改成：
    def _mark_issues(self, issues, now):
        for iss in issues:
            self._active_issues[iss] = now

    def _get_active_issues(self, now):
        return [i for i, t in self._active_issues.items()
                if now - t <= self._issue_ttl]
```

`_update_display` 变得很简单：

```python
def _update_display(self):
    now = time.time()
    with self._lock:
        info = self._latest_info
        score = self._latest_score
        new_issues = list(self._latest_issues)
        self._latest_issues = []

    if info is None:
        return

    self._mark_issues(new_issues, now)
    # 清理过期问题
    self._active_issues = {
        i: t for i, t in self._active_issues.items()
        if now - t <= self._issue_ttl
    }

    if now - self._last_report_time >= AudioConfig.REPORT_INTERVAL_SEC:
        gain_sug = self.gain_advisor.get_suggestion()
        self.ui.render(info, score, self.thresholds,
                       self._get_active_issues(now), gain_sug)
        self._last_report_time = now
```

记得在 `start()` 校准完之后、进入循环之前，先 `print("\n" * TerminalUI.PANEL_HEIGHT)` 预留出面板空间，让第一次抬光标有地方抬。

效果就是：一个固定在终端底部的 10 行面板，上面是实时音量条，下面要么是"✅ 正常"，要么是当前最严重的 1-2 个问题 + 改进建议，一切原地刷新不滚屏。

## ChatGPT:
能看到完整聊天内容。开始写之前，补充几个前面没提到的点：

**转写代码**
- `pending_final` 队列目前无上限，极端情况下定稿若追不上，commit 延迟会越来越大。会加一个简单的上限保护。
- `without_timestamps=True` 在 faster-whisper 某些老版本上可能和 `vad_filter` 冲突，异常回退逻辑里需要一起去掉。

**音频监测**
- Windows 终端默认不解析 ANSI 转义码，需要开 VT 模式（`SetConsoleMode`），不然面板会变成一堆乱码。
- 中文/emoji 的终端显示宽度不固定，右边框很难对齐。我用"只画左边框"的方案，视觉上干净且绝对不会错位。
- 校准时 `low_freq_baseline` 混进了说话段的低频，不太纯。会改成只用低 RMS 的"安静帧"来算基线，风噪判断会更准。
- `_cached_gain` 建议在面板内常驻显示，不要再 `print()` 另起行破坏面板。

下面是改好的两份代码。

---

## 1. 转写代码（完整文件）

```python
import os
os.environ["HF_ENDPOINT"] = "https://hf-mirror.com"
os.environ["HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET"] = "1"
os.environ["HF_HUB_DISABLE_SYMLINKS_WARNING"] = "1"

import queue
import re
import sys
import threading
import time
import wave
from collections import deque
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import sounddevice as sd
from faster_whisper import WhisperModel

# ===== 配置 =====
PARTIAL_MODEL_NAME = "base"     # 预览用：轻、快，CPU int8 大约比 small 快一倍
FINAL_MODEL_NAME = "medium"     # 定稿用：准
USE_DUAL_MODEL = True           # 内存紧张改成 False

LANGUAGE = "zh"
SAMPLE_RATE = 16000
BLOCK_DURATION = 0.03
BLOCK_SIZE = int(SAMPLE_RATE * BLOCK_DURATION)

CALIBRATION_SECONDS = 1.0
THRESHOLD_MULTIPLIER = 2.5
MIN_THRESHOLD = 0.004
MAX_THRESHOLD = 0.050

COMMIT_SILENCE = 1.0
PRE_ROLL = 0.4
MAX_SEGMENT_DURATION = 20.0
MIN_SEGMENT_DURATION = 0.5

PARTIAL_MIN_DURATION = 0.6
PARTIAL_INTERVAL = 0.35
PARTIAL_WINDOW_SEC = 5.0        # partial 只识别最近这几秒，避免越滚越慢

MAX_PENDING_FINAL = 4           # 定稿队列上限，防堆积

HOT_WORDS = "嗯，好的，我们来聊一聊。"
# ================

_ts = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
LOG_FILE = Path(f"transcript_{_ts}.txt")
AUDIO_FILE = Path(f"audio_{_ts}.wav")

_vad_available = True
_without_timestamps_ok = True

HALLUCINATION_PATTERNS = [
    r"请?使用简体中文",
    r"保留?标点符号",
    r"以下是普通话",
    r"请不吝点赞",
    r"字幕[由组].{0,20}(提供|制作|翻译)",
    r"明镜与?点点栏目",
    r"^谢谢(大家)?(观看|收看)[。.!！]?$",
    r"^请订阅[。.!！]?$",
    r"^(多谢|感谢)(大家)?(观看|收看|聆听)",
    r"MBC\s*뉴스",
    r"下集?再见",
    r"中文字幕",
]
_hallu_re = re.compile("|".join(HALLUCINATION_PATTERNS))


def is_hallucination(text: str) -> bool:
    if not text:
        return True
    t = text.strip()
    if not t:
        return True
    if _hallu_re.search(t):
        return True
    if len(t) >= 6:
        half = len(t) // 2
        for size in range(2, half + 1):
            chunk = t[:size]
            if chunk * 3 in t:
                return True
    return False


def clean_text(text: str) -> str:
    if not text:
        return ""
    parts = re.split(r"(?<=[。！？!?.])", text)
    kept = [p for p in parts if p.strip() and not _hallu_re.search(p)]
    return "".join(kept).strip()


def calibrate(seconds):
    print(f"🔧 测环境噪声 {seconds:.1f} 秒，别说话...")
    rec = sd.rec(int(seconds * SAMPLE_RATE), samplerate=SAMPLE_RATE,
                 channels=1, dtype="float32")
    sd.wait()
    f = rec.flatten()
    n = max(1, len(f) // BLOCK_SIZE)
    rms_list = [float(np.sqrt(np.mean(f[i*BLOCK_SIZE:(i+1)*BLOCK_SIZE]**2)))
                for i in range(n)]
    noise = float(np.median(rms_list))
    th = float(np.clip(noise * THRESHOLD_MULTIPLIER, MIN_THRESHOLD, MAX_THRESHOLD))
    print(f"   噪声≈{noise:.5f}  触发阈值={th:.5f}\n")
    return th


def transcribe(audio, model, final=False):
    """
    关键改动：
      - best_of 恒为 1（temperature=0 时 best_of 无效，设 5 只是空转）
      - partial 也开 VAD，跳过静音段
      - without_timestamps=True，省一点开销
    """
    global _vad_available, _without_timestamps_ok

    peak = float(np.max(np.abs(audio)))
    if peak > 1e-6:
        audio = (audio * (0.95 / peak)).astype(np.float32)
    else:
        audio = audio.astype(np.float32)

    kwargs = dict(
        language=LANGUAGE,
        beam_size=5 if final else 1,
        best_of=1,
        temperature=0.0,
        condition_on_previous_text=False,
        hotwords=HOT_WORDS,
        no_speech_threshold=0.6,
        log_prob_threshold=-0.8,
        compression_ratio_threshold=2.4,
    )
    if _without_timestamps_ok:
        kwargs["without_timestamps"] = True
    if _vad_available:
        kwargs["vad_filter"] = True
        kwargs["vad_parameters"] = dict(
            min_silence_duration_ms=300 if final else 200
        )

    def _run(kw):
        segs, _ = model.transcribe(audio, **kw)
        return "".join(s.text for s in segs).strip()

    try:
        text = _run(kwargs)
    except TypeError:
        # 老版本可能不认 hotwords / without_timestamps
        kwargs.pop("hotwords", None)
        kwargs.pop("without_timestamps", None)
        _without_timestamps_ok = False
        text = _run(kwargs)
    except Exception as e:
        msg = str(e).lower()
        if _vad_available and ("vad" in msg or "onnx" in msg):
            _vad_available = False
            kwargs.pop("vad_filter", None)
            kwargs.pop("vad_parameters", None)
            text = _run(kwargs)
        else:
            raise

    return clean_text(text)


def load_model(name):
    print(f"⏳ 加载模型 {name}...")
    t0 = time.time()
    # cpu_threads 过多反而因为上下文切换变慢
    m = WhisperModel(name, device="cpu", compute_type="int8",
                     cpu_threads=4, num_workers=1)
    print(f"   ✅ 完成（{time.time() - t0:.1f}s）")
    return m


def main():
    final_model = load_model(FINAL_MODEL_NAME)
    if USE_DUAL_MODEL and PARTIAL_MODEL_NAME != FINAL_MODEL_NAME:
        partial_model = load_model(PARTIAL_MODEL_NAME)
    else:
        partial_model = final_model
    print()

    threshold = calibrate(CALIBRATION_SECONDS)

    wav_fp = wave.open(str(AUDIO_FILE), "wb")
    wav_fp.setnchannels(1)
    wav_fp.setsampwidth(2)
    wav_fp.setframerate(SAMPLE_RATE)
    wav_lock = threading.Lock()

    print(f"📝 文字保存到：{LOG_FILE}")
    print(f"🎵 音频保存到：{AUDIO_FILE}")
    print("💡 底部 ✏️ 是实时预览（小模型），停顿后由大模型定稿")
    print("💡 Ctrl+C 退出\n")
    print("=" * 60)

    audio_q = queue.Queue()
    stop_evt = threading.Event()
    counter = [0]
    log_fp = LOG_FILE.open("a", encoding="utf-8")

    task_lock = threading.Lock()
    pending_partial = [None]
    pending_final = queue.Queue()

    current_partial_text = [""]
    partial_shown = [False]

    def clear_line():
        sys.stdout.write("\r" + " " * 100 + "\r")
        sys.stdout.flush()

    def commit(text):
        counter[0] += 1
        ts = datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M:%S")
        line = f"[{counter[0]:03d}] {ts}  {text}"
        clear_line()
        print(line)
        log_fp.write(line + "\n")
        log_fp.flush()
        current_partial_text[0] = ""
        partial_shown[0] = False

    def show_partial(text):
        if not text or text == current_partial_text[0]:
            return
        current_partial_text[0] = text
        clear_line()
        shown = text[-70:] if len(text) > 70 else text
        sys.stdout.write(f"  ✏️  {shown}")
        sys.stdout.flush()
        partial_shown[0] = True

    def show_hint(msg):
        if partial_shown[0]:
            return
        clear_line()
        sys.stdout.write(msg)
        sys.stdout.flush()

    def write_wav(block_float):
        pcm = np.clip(block_float * 32767.0, -32768, 32767).astype(np.int16)
        with wav_lock:
            try:
                wav_fp.writeframes(pcm.tobytes())
            except Exception:
                pass

    def rec_cb(indata, frames, ti, s):
        audio_q.put(indata.copy().flatten())

    def asr_worker():
        while not stop_evt.is_set():
            # 定稿优先
            try:
                audio = pending_final.get(timeout=0.1)
                try:
                    text = transcribe(audio, final_model, final=True)
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"\n[定稿识别出错] {e}")
                    text = ""
                if text and not is_hallucination(text):
                    commit(text)
                else:
                    clear_line()
                    current_partial_text[0] = ""
                    partial_shown[0] = False
                continue
            except queue.Empty:
                pass

            # 定稿没活了，才处理 partial
            with task_lock:
                audio = pending_partial[0]
                pending_partial[0] = None
            if audio is not None:
                try:
                    text = transcribe(audio, partial_model, final=False)
                except Exception:
                    text = ""
                if text and not is_hallucination(text):
                    # 处理期间若有新的定稿任务进来，就不显示过期 partial
                    if pending_final.empty():
                        show_partial(text)

    def processor():
        pre_blocks = int(PRE_ROLL / BLOCK_DURATION)
        pre_roll = deque(maxlen=pre_blocks)
        buf = []
        has_speech = False
        silence_blocks = 0
        last_partial_t = 0.0
        silence_lim = int(COMMIT_SILENCE / BLOCK_DURATION)
        max_blocks = int(MAX_SEGMENT_DURATION / BLOCK_DURATION)
        min_blocks = int(MIN_SEGMENT_DURATION / BLOCK_DURATION)
        partial_blocks = int(PARTIAL_WINDOW_SEC / BLOCK_DURATION)

        while not stop_evt.is_set():
            try:
                block = audio_q.get(timeout=0.2)
            except queue.Empty:
                continue

            write_wav(block)

            rms = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(block ** 2)))

            if not has_speech:
                pre_roll.append(block)
                if rms > threshold:
                    has_speech = True
                    buf = list(pre_roll)
                    buf.append(block)
                    silence_blocks = 0
                    last_partial_t = time.time()
                    show_hint("  🎙️  听到了，继续说...")
            else:
                buf.append(block)
                if rms > threshold:
                    silence_blocks = 0
                else:
                    silence_blocks += 1

            need_commit = has_speech and (
                silence_blocks >= silence_lim or len(buf) >= max_blocks
            )

            now = time.time()
            if (has_speech and not need_commit
                    and len(buf) * BLOCK_DURATION >= PARTIAL_MIN_DURATION
                    and (now - last_partial_t) >= PARTIAL_INTERVAL):
                # 只截最近 PARTIAL_WINDOW_SEC 秒
                if len(buf) > partial_blocks:
                    snap = np.concatenate(buf[-partial_blocks:]).copy()
                else:
                    snap = np.concatenate(buf).copy()
                with task_lock:
                    pending_partial[0] = snap
                last_partial_t = now

            if need_commit:
                audio_arr = np.concatenate(buf)
                overall_rms = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(audio_arr ** 2)))
                if len(buf) >= min_blocks and overall_rms > threshold * 0.8:
                    # 定稿队列上限保护
                    if pending_final.qsize() < MAX_PENDING_FINAL:
                        pending_final.put(audio_arr)
                    else:
                        # 实在堆不下就丢最老的那条
                        try:
                            pending_final.get_nowait()
                        except queue.Empty:
                            pass
                        pending_final.put(audio_arr)
                else:
                    clear_line()
                    current_partial_text[0] = ""
                    partial_shown[0] = False
                buf = []
                has_speech = False
                silence_blocks = 0
                pre_roll.clear()
                with task_lock:
                    pending_partial[0] = None

    threading.Thread(target=processor, daemon=True).start()
    threading.Thread(target=asr_worker, daemon=True).start()

    try:
        with sd.InputStream(samplerate=SAMPLE_RATE, channels=1, dtype="float32",
                            blocksize=BLOCK_SIZE, callback=rec_cb):
            while True:
                sd.sleep(200)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\n")
    finally:
        stop_evt.set()
        time.sleep(0.5)
        log_fp.close()
        with wav_lock:
            try:
                wav_fp.close()
            except Exception:
                pass
        print("=" * 60)
        print(f"共识别 {counter[0]} 句")
        print(f"文字 → {LOG_FILE}")
        print(f"音频 → {AUDIO_FILE}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
def _enable_terminal_features():
    """Windows 下开启 VT 模式；统一 stdout 为 UTF-8。"""
    if os.name == "nt":
        try:
            import ctypes
            kernel32 = ctypes.windll.kernel32
            kernel32.SetConsoleMode(kernel32.GetStdHandle(-11), 7)
        except Exception:
            pass
    try:
        sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    except Exception:
        pass


_enable_terminal_features()
```
